title: Degree-one coordinates of a linear map in pulled-back module frames
statement: Let f:T→S be a morphism of Noetherian schemes, F a rank-r locally free module on S, G a rank-s locally free module on T, and m:f^*F→G any module morphism (not assumed invertible). Let v:V(G)→V(F) satisfy the scalar and generator equations MapSpec for the adjoint of m. Choose module frames eS on V⊆S and eT on U⊆T. Let W be any scheme with a:W→U and g:W→V such that (a U.ι) f=g V.ι. Pull the frames to W using the usual pullback, its composition isomorphism, restriction-to-pullback comparison and canonical free-module pullback isomorphism. Express the pullback of m in these frames as the free-module map c (framedPullbackMap). For any lift k of affineTraceMap(a) followed by the inverse eT chart and v into V(F)|V, the j-th forward eS coordinate of k is sum_i pi_W^*(freeMatrix(c)_{i,j}) x_i. This is an individual degree-one equation for an explicitly given rectangular matrix. It makes no assertion about existence of an invertible matrix or equality of inverse charts.

source.place: paragraph 2, symmetric-algebra linear-coordinate calculation; also literature/stacks-project/constructions.tex, sections Relative spectrum and Vector bundles (lemma-spec-properties and lemma-category-vector-bundles)

proof.text: Apply the generator equation of MapSpec to the source frame section. Its module image is the pullback-adjunction image of m. The canonical composition and restriction-to-pullback comparisons identify its pullback to W with the image of the standard j-th source section under framedPullbackMap.

Expand this image in the standard global basis of the target free module. The coefficients are freeMatrix(c)_{i,j}. Linearity of the degree-one symmetric-algebra inclusion and its structure-algebra isomorphism carries this finite expansion to the corresponding linear combination of degree-one functions.

The inverse target chart takes the target degree-one basis functions to the ordered polynomial coordinates; the affine tower comparison identifies these with affineTraceCoordinate. Restriction via the open inclusion and topIso identifies the source degree-one function with its forward-chart coordinate. Pullback on scalar functions is pi_W.appTop, giving the stated formula. Empty bases yield empty sums; no nonempty or affine condition on W was used.

proof_origin.place: paragraph 2, the generator calculation isolated from the matrix invertibility and inverse-chart comparison

theorem map_frame_coordinates
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] [IsNoetherian T]
    (f : T ⟶ S) (r s : ℕ) (F : S.Modules) (G : T.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r] [G.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank s]
    (m : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F ⟶ G)
    (v : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme T s G ⟶ VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme S r F)
    (hv : VectorTraceGeometry.MapSpec f r s F G
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).homEquiv _ _ m) v)
    (V : S.Opens) (eS : Trivialization S r F V)
    (U : T.Opens) (eT : Trivialization T s G U)
    (W : Scheme.{u}) (a : W ⟶ U.toScheme) (g : W ⟶ V.toScheme)
    (h : (a ≫ U.ι) ≫ f = g ≫ V.ι)
    (k : affineTraceTower W s ⟶ ((π S r F) ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (hk : k ≫ ((π S r F) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι =
      (affineTraceMap a s ≫ Etale.vectorIntegrationChart T s G U eT) ≫ v)
    (j : Fin r) :
    (k ≫ trivializationMap S r F V eS).appTop (AffineSpace.coord V.toScheme (ULift.up j)) =
      ∑ i : Fin s, (affineTraceProjection W s).appTop
        (Scheme.Modules.freeMatrix (framedPullbackMap f r s F G m V eS U eT a g h)
          (ULift.up i) (ULift.up j)) * affineTraceCoordinate W s i
